members: @Override public Mono<EventRecord> findLatest(String deviceId, String metric, Instant tDevice) { return databaseClient.sql("SELECT revision, t_ingress, sample_value, validation_status FROM telemetry_record WHERE device_id = :deviceId AND metric = :metric AND t_device = :deviceTime ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1").bind("deviceId", deviceId).bind("metric", metric).bind("deviceTime", OffsetDateTime.ofInstant(tDevice, ZoneOffset.UTC)).map(row -> { int revision = row.get("revision", Number.class).intValue(); TelemetrySample stored = new TelemetrySample(deviceId, metric, tDevice, row.get("t_ingress", OffsetDateTime.class).toInstant(), row.get("sample_value", Number.class).doubleValue(), row.get("validation_status", String.class), ""); return new EventRecord(stored, revision, revision == 1 ? EventRecord.KIND_RECORD : EventRecord.KIND_REVISION); }).one(); }
